tokens.name: chassis
tokens.usage: Page background — the gallery wall. White in Gallery, black in Night. Everything sits on chassis.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Same as chassis: Panels are not boxes. They are opened by a 2px rule and sit directly on the wall. Knob caps use it too.

tokens.name: key
tokens.usage: Face of plain Keys and Selector options. No outline: the face and the shadow-key edge define them. Ink text on it ≥15:1.

tokens.name: panel-sunk
tokens.usage: Recessed wells: Field inputs, Fader and Switch tracks, stepper readouts.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text, headlines and rules. Pure black on white, pure white on black (21:1).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: Labels, units, metadata. ≥5.5:1 on chassis and panel-sunk in both themes.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines, unlit LEDs, inactive ticks, the edge of a Display on black. Decorative only.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: The 2px black (Night: white) rule that opens every Panel and section — the system's main divider, in place of boxes and borders.

tokens.name: signal
tokens.usage: THE accent. A fill for the one live thing on screen: the primary Key, an active value arc, a lit LED. Never text on chassis (2.4:1) — use signal-text.

tokens.name: signal-text
tokens.usage: Accent-coloured text on chassis or panel (≥5:1 both themes).

tokens.name: on-signal
tokens.usage: Text and glyphs on a signal fill (6:1). Never white.

tokens.name: blue
tokens.usage: Secondary function key colour (shift, mode, settings). Fill only.

tokens.name: on-blue
tokens.usage: Text on a blue fill (5.3:1).

tokens.name: yellow
tokens.usage: Tertiary function key colour (copy, hold, favourite). Fill only, sparingly.

tokens.name: on-yellow
tokens.usage: Text on a yellow fill.

tokens.name: lcd
tokens.usage: Display screen background — dark in both themes, like real glass.

tokens.name: lcd-ink
tokens.usage: Lit text and segments on lcd.

tokens.name: lcd-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on lcd (5.7:1).

tokens.name: lcd-dim
tokens.usage: Unlit meter segments on lcd. Decorative.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset. Ink, not signal — signal fails 3:1 on aluminum.

families.sans: "Libre Franklin", "Franklin Gothic Medium", "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif
families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, monospace

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: App names on splash and empty states — type as the image. One per screen.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Hold shift to fine-tune any knob.

styles.name: input
styles.usage: Text typed into any input, select or textarea. 16px is the floor: below it iOS zooms the page on focus. Mono fields use the same size.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Control, Key and section labels. Always UPPERCASE (text-transform). Panel titles use it at 13px in ink.

styles.name: readout
styles.usage: Numbers that change on their own (timers, counters) on a Display. Tabular, zero-padded.

styles.name: value
styles.usage: Inline control values (Knob, Fader). Zero-padded to 3 digits.

styles.name: micro
styles.usage: Key indices, tick numbers. Never for anything a person must read to act.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Base unit. Label-to-control gap, LED offset.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between Keys in a row; inner padding of small controls.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Key inner padding; Panel header padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel body padding; gap between controls in a module.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between Panels; screen edge padding on mobile.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Section breaks; screen edge padding on desktop.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Major vertical rhythm between screen regions.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Everything else: Keys, Selectors, Panels, Displays, wells. Square is the default.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Switch tracks and thumbs only.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Knobs and LEDs only. Never on Keys or Panels.

shadow.note: Flat by default. The only shadow is the keycap edge, which collapses when pressed.

tokens.name: shadow-key
tokens.usage: Resting Key edge — with no outline, this is what makes a Key read as raised.

tokens.name: shadow-key-pressed
tokens.usage: Key while pressed or latched (paired with a 2px translateY).
